ruledBy: Astra editorial review, adopted as Al's ruling (his instruction, 2026-09-05; veto list: none)
note: KEEP and FIX (fixed wording) are kept. KILL is held as `unruled`, NOT rejected — Al ruled that explicitly, so no downstream step may treat a KILL as struck. New-lines CSV rows are kept with source astra-new. astraTime is Astra's own visual reading of the hour and does not override the photograph's rotation slot.

kept.text: Keep the plans vague; the neighbours won't notice.
One thing at a time. Convenient, really.

unruled.text: The herd is all here; the fog is just rationing them one at a time.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: narrates the partly visible herd.

unruled.text: Visibility is down to one cow.
unruled.reason: R1/R5 fail: reports visibility using the pictured cow.

unruled.text: The farm goes on past that white wall; the cows are taking that on faith.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: explains the obscured farm through the cows.

kept.text: Finding your own gate now counts as the first errand.
Leave early. Familiar roads need introductions too.

unruled.text: Three streetlights in and the street gives up; the fog holds the rest.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: counts visible lamps and describes disappearing road.

unruled.text: The fog rolled in at three and started deleting the neighbourhood from the far end.
unruled.reason: R1/R5 fail: condition opener narrates the obscured neighbourhood.

unruled.text: The streetlights are trying their best.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: anthropomorphises visible lights without adding a human consequence.

kept.text: Don't feel obliged to join the day before coffee.
Coffee first. Then we can discuss going anywhere.

unruled.text: One lit window is taking on the whole fog, and losing beautifully.
unruled.reason: R2/R5 fail: window caption ends in scenic admiration.

unruled.text: The fog is thick enough to hold a beam of kitchen light like a solid object.
unruled.reason: R1/R5 fail: explains the light beam.

unruled.text: The morning forgot to render.
unruled.reason: R7 fail: software metaphor substitutes for ordinary experience.

kept.text: Those headlights have been 'almost here' for two full minutes of fog.
The school run now involves finding the school.
kept.fixedFrom: Fog like this turns every school run into an act of faith and reflective tape.

kept.text: Your lift has been nearly here for quite a while.
Bags ready. The bus is keeping its location vague.

unruled.text: The hi-vis is doing exactly what it was bought for this morning.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: explains the visible safety vest.

kept.text: How much of this walk did you actually promise?
Same route. More imagination required.

unruled.text: The trees go up about thirty metres and then just stop existing.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: describes the obscured treetops.

unruled.text: The forest is keeping its top half private this morning.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: privacy metaphor captions the forest.

unruled.text: The road is the only thing committing to a direction this morning.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: personifies the visible road instead of a reader's decision.

kept.text: Nobody saw your last shot. This could help your score.
kept.fixedFrom: Fog gives every golfer the same handicap, and today it is generous.

kept.text: Your best shot has conveniently gone unwitnessed.
On the green. That's your story, anyway.

unruled.text: Found: one ball. The other three hundred metres of golf course are still missing.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: inventories the ball and hidden course.

unruled.text: The fairway is out there somewhere, taking the morning off from being visible.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: explains the obscured fairway.

kept.text: The neighbours can't judge your slippers from there.
Wave anyway. One of them may owe you money.

unruled.text: The cat can see exactly what is in that fog and is choosing not to say.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: cat secrecy decorates its pictured gaze.

unruled.text: The neighbours are out there somewhere, at about ten percent opacity.
unruled.reason: R5/R7 fail: describes hidden houses in software language.

unruled.text: Silent Hill vibes. Without the monsters. Hopefully.
unruled.reason: R7 fail: borrowed franchise reference and 'vibes' replace the joke.

kept.text: The road home takes longer than your hunger allows.
kept.fixedFrom: Mist off the veld at dusk: the road home just doubled in length.

kept.text: Dinner will understand why you're taking your time.
The shortcut can wait. So can the person behind you.

unruled.text: The bushveld has gone soft-focus and the Landy is taking it slowly.
unruled.reason: R5/R7 fail: scenic label and vehicle narration.

unruled.text: Headlights do about twenty metres out here; the rest is memory and respect.
unruled.reason: R1/R7 fail: invented sight distance becomes driving advice.

kept.text: Home is two hundred metres away and completely theoretical right now.
Nearly home, you said, with impressive confidence.
Same street. Suddenly you want the house number.

unruled.text: Those brake lights are the only warm colour left in the neighbourhood.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: describes brake-light colour.

unruled.text: The fog swallowed the whole street and left the tail lights as a receipt.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: receipt metaphor captions visible tail lights.

kept.text: The dog knows this route with its nose, which tonight is the better instrument.
The evening walk now comes with frequent roll calls.
Stay close. The dog wasn't asking you.

unruled.text: Every streetlamp gets its own halo tonight; the fog is generous like that.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: explains the lamps' halos.

unruled.text: The sea is somewhere just off to the right; you'll have to take it on hearsay.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: describes the absent sea through an imagined report.

kept.text: Your holiday photos could have been taken at home.
Lovely view. We'll take your word for it.

unruled.text: The viewpoint is performing at zero percent and the selfie is happening anyway.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: narrates the pictured selfie against the absent view.

unruled.text: Somewhere behind all that white is a famous view. Allegedly.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: comments only on the missing scenery.

unruled.text: The fog got to the lookout first and took the whole view for itself.
unruled.reason: R1/R5 fail: condition opener and possessive view metaphor.

kept.text: The late-night milk run has become a bigger request.
Milk can wait. Tea without it builds character.

unruled.text: Cape Town is still on under there; the fog is just running interference.
unruled.reason: R5/R7 fail: city-specific caption of lights under mist.

unruled.text: The sea mist came in for the night and the whole city went soft.
unruled.reason: R1/R5 fail: describes the city's softened appearance.

unruled.text: Table Mountain kept its head out; the city took the blanket.
unruled.reason: R5/R7 fail: landmark-and-city blanket metaphor.

kept.text: Supper will need another minute in the oven.
kept.fixedFrom: Wet tar, white air: the last leg home is the slow one tonight.

kept.text: Your lift is taking its time, which is reassuring.
Still on the way. Supper can have another minute.

unruled.text: Last taxis of the night, and the fog has the whole rank to itself soon.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: narrates the taxi rank.

unruled.text: The rank lights are punching holes in the fog, one bay at a time.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: describes lights penetrating mist.

kept.text: You've never been so pleased to recognise your gate.
Home at last. Your slippers have been expecting you.

unruled.text: The kitchen light found him halfway up the path, which is what it is for.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: explains the pictured man in the light beam.

unruled.text: The fog followed him right up to the gate and stopped at the window's beam.
unruled.reason: R1/R5 fail: narrates the gate and light.

unruled.text: That one window is doing lighthouse duty tonight, and it is enough.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: lighthouse metaphor describes the window beam.

kept.text: Let the driver behind you discover patience.
No rush. Your turn-off isn't going anywhere.

unruled.text: The fog is so thick even the robot is hedging its bets.
unruled.reason: R1/R5 fail: condition opener captions the signal's unusual lights.

unruled.text: Nobody is coming through that white, but the robot keeps performing anyway.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: describes the empty intersection and working signal.

unruled.text: The intersection is running on trust and thirty metres of visibility.
unruled.reason: R1 fail: invented visibility measurement replaces the human consequence.

kept.text: You can explain being late without inventing traffic.
The long way home? Hard to tell tonight.

unruled.text: The street is his alone tonight; the fog bought out every other pedestrian.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: describes the lone pedestrian.

unruled.text: One streetlight is doing moon duty for the whole block.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: moon metaphor captions the streetlight.

unruled.text: Everything looks like a film scene. A creepy one.
unruled.reason: R5/R7 fail: generic film comparison without an everyday payoff.

kept.text: Your morning walk starts by finding the morning.
Coffee first. The view can introduce itself later.

unruled.text: The sun is coming through the fog at half strength and full gold.
unruled.reason: R1/R5 fail: describes sunlight and colour.

unruled.text: The mist gets the farm; the frost gets the verges; the road splits the difference.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: inventories mist, frost and road.

unruled.text: This gold lasts exactly as long as the fog does, which is the deal.
unruled.reason: R2/R5 fail: scenic colour caption.

kept.text: The early start has yet to produce a clear advantage.
All dressed up. Still waiting for the day to appear.

unruled.text: The fog filled the valley overnight; the Ngunis are standing on its shoreline.
unruled.reason: R1/R5 fail: narrates herd and valley.

unruled.text: Fog settles in the low ground, which is why the herd sleeps on the hill.
unruled.reason: R3/R5 fail: weather lesson explains the herd's position.

unruled.text: Three Ngunis watching the fog like it owes them a field.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: gives the visible cattle a complaint about scenery.

kept.text: You packed boots. Bring some patience as well.
kept.fixedFrom: The field is regulation size; you just have to take that on faith today.

kept.text: Kick-off can wait. The tea won't keep itself warm.
kept.fixedFrom: Saturday rugby waits for the fog, and the fog is in no hurry.

kept.text: Did the whole team arrive, or just the captain?
Kick-off soon. Finding the other end comes first.

unruled.text: Kickoff is ten and the far posts have not arrived yet.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: missing-posts caption with an invented kick-off time.

kept.text: The GPS says the road is there, and today that is the whole case for it.
Take your time. The queue behind you can too.
kept.fixedFrom: Twenty in a sixty and completely correct about it.

kept.text: You know this road until someone asks which turning.
No rush. You're entitled to recognise the turn.

unruled.text: The phone knows the route; the fog is testing how much he trusts it.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: explains the driver's visible reliance on the phone.

kept.text: Tonight's visitors may need collecting at the gate.
You sent the address. Now send encouragement.

unruled.text: The fog took the city but it is not getting the Bo-Kaap's colours.
unruled.reason: R1/R5 fail: condition opener narrates local colour.

unruled.text: The whole city has gone grey below; this street refused, on principle.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: personifies the pictured colour contrast.

unruled.text: The mist gets thicker downhill, and the houses get louder to compensate.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: describes colour against obscurity.

kept.text: Your bicycle can enjoy being taken for a walk.
kept.fixedFrom: Too misty to ride, which neither of them minds in the slightest.

kept.text: The ride home has been renamed quality time.
Nice walk. The bike is also getting some exercise.

unruled.text: The fog turned the ride home into a walk, and the walk is better.
unruled.reason: R1/R2 fail: condition opener and imposed scenic approval.

unruled.text: Mist in the oaks, gables in the mist: the Boland doing its winter thing.
unruled.reason: R2/R5 fail: regional tourism caption.

kept.text: Dinner is looking like the highlight of your holiday.
The table has a view. Ask for the menu instead.

unruled.text: Every boat is staying exactly where it is, and the fog approves.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: describes the moored boats.

unruled.text: The masts have gone to silhouettes and the restaurant has gone to gold.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: describes silhouettes and restaurant light.

unruled.text: Nothing sails in this; even the oystercatcher is walking.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: explains boats and the pictured bird.

kept.text: Nobody can tell how long you've been in your gown.
One look outside. That settles going out.

unruled.text: The city noise is off tonight; fog is the best soundproofing there is.
unruled.reason: R1/R3 fail: unsupported soundproofing claim substitutes for a joke.

unruled.text: The streetlights have gone soft and the whole suburb has gone quiet.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: lighting-and-mood description.

unruled.text: Fog outside, blanket outside too: some weather is for watching from one metre away.
unruled.reason: R1/R5 fail: condition opener explains the blanket on the balcony.

kept.text: Your evening plans are within calling distance.
Still coming over? Describe your gate again.

unruled.text: The whole street has gone amber tonight; the fog is holding the light like syrup.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: syrup metaphor describes amber light.

unruled.text: Friday night fog: the block gets quieter, the streetlights get bigger.
unruled.reason: R1/R5 fail: condition label and lamp description.

unruled.text: The fog moved in an hour ago and the streetlights have doubled in size since.
unruled.reason: R1/R5 fail: condition opener narrates the halos.

kept.text: Best let the dog pretend it knows where you are.
You're both on a walk. Only one seems briefed.

unruled.text: The dog is definitely still on the end of that leash. Almost definitely.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: restates the hidden-dog visual joke.

unruled.text: The leash goes into the fog and only faith comes back out of it.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: explains the leash disappearing into mist.

unruled.text: Current visibility: one whole dog short of complete.
unruled.reason: R1/R5 fail: visibility report built from the pictured missing dog.

kept.text: The bin run now requires more planning than breakfast.
kept.fixedFrom: The bin run is being flown on instruments this morning.

kept.text: Walking to the bin is now an expedition.
Your first errand has become a test of commitment.
Five steps out. Already considering provisions.

unruled.text: Gown, slippers, thirty metres of visibility: bin day waits for no weather.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: inventories gown, slippers and visibility.

kept.text: You can postpone the neighbourly wave until later.
You're awake. The suburb hasn't introduced itself.

unruled.text: The fog is lying in the streets like it pays rates here.
unruled.reason: R1/R5 fail: condition opener decorates mist lying between houses.

unruled.text: Sun from above, fog from below: the suburb is the middle of the sandwich.
unruled.reason: R5 fail: sandwich metaphor captions layers in the photograph.

unruled.text: The fog got in among the houses overnight and the sun is evicting it street by street.
unruled.reason: R1/R5 fail: narrates mist clearing between houses.
